item.title: AXI-S Slave Interface Design
item.description: Developing a module or a design with a standard interface offers significant convenience to the RTL designer. It brings the advantages of being easy to integrate into other projects and of sharing a common structure that is compatible with designs developed by others.

item.title: PWM Signal Generation with VHDL and Verilog
item.description:
– PWM Signal Generation with VHDL and Verilog

PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) is an output format widely used in electronic applications, in which the value of the output is controlled by varying the amount of time the digital output stays active. With this output format, the effect of an analogue output can be produced using only a digital signal. It is also possible to transfer data between digital systems by making use of the timing parameters of the PWM signal.

item.title: Reset Topologies in FPGA
item.description:
–

In FPGA applications the reset architecture is extremely critical for the reliability of the design. Reset structures play a key role, particularly in space, aviation and other mission-critical systems, in quickly preventing possible faults and in defining the behaviour of the system at start-up.

item.title: Moving Average Filter with VHDL
item.description:
Moving Average Filter

A moving average filter is a filter that takes the average of successive input samples and outputs the result. It produces a stable output in response to abruptly and randomly changing inputs. Mathematically it is a convolution with a fixed-width Finite Impulse Response (FIR) function. It has a low-pass characteristic. Although it performs well in the time domain, it does not give good results in the frequency domain.
